name: gap-run-policy-failure-guard
about: runPolicy.failureGuard（pilot/config/parseRunPolicyConfig.ts、agent/policy/FailureGuard.ts、InProcessGateway.ts:1346-1382）：toolFailureLimits.read_file=2 与 toolLabels，模型在一轮里反复读不存在的文件（tool_execution_failed 计数），第二次失败时守卫跳闸：run_policy_stopped 状态、中文提示、会话中止。比较事件序列、请求次数与会话记录。
config:
schemaVersion: 1
agent:
  model: bbx/deterministic
  maxContextTokens: 65536
  maxOutputTokens: 8192
model:
  providers:
    bbx:
      protocol: openai
      url: {MOCK}/v1
      apiKey: bbx-mock-only
      models:
        deterministic:
          capabilities:
            supportsToolUse: true
            maxContextTokens: 65536
            maxOutputTokens: 8192
telemetry:
  enabled: false
runPolicy:
  failureGuard:
    enabled: true
    toolFailureLimits:
      read_file: 2
    toolLabels:
      read_file: 文件读取
